newsitem.title: MEXICO: Bufete receives $35.4 mln from sale.
newsitem.headline: Bufete receives $35.4 mln from sale.

text.p: Bufete Industrial SA de CV, Mexico's engineering and constrcution firm, said Wednesday that on May 12 it received $35.4 million from the sale of Mexpetrol SA's 67 percent shareholding in Mexpetrol Argentina.
Bufete said it expected to receive a total of $40 million from the sale to oil giant YPF SA and oil firm ASTRA CAPSA for $204 million.
"Bufete will use the proceeds principally to retire debt," the company said in a statement.
Mexpetrol is a consortium of Mexican oil monopoly Petroleos Mexicanos (Pemex) and privately owned Mexican engineering and construction companies, including Bufete.
Mexpetrol Argentina participates with YPF and ASTRA in exploration and production activities in the Argentine oil field El Porton-Buta Ranquil, in the Neuquen province.

Bufete said the total amount it expects to receive is based on the value of the oil deposit on March 31, 1997 (the date a preliminary accord for the sale was reached) and an adjustment to be made afterwards to reflect the difference in value, if any, between that date and April 30 when the final contract was signed.
